title: probeResult:v1
description: Result of one Gnomon M1.0 probe run on one platform (spec §19.1 M1.0; research 29 §2). Written by packages/gnomon/probes/run.mjs to probes/results/<probe>.<os>.json. A `fail` on a ruling means a re-plan memo before any build that depends on it.

probe.description: Probe id; equals the directory name under probes/.

os.description: process.platform of the host that ran the probe.

osVersion.description: Human OS version (e.g. macOS product version, Windows build).

arch.description: process.arch of the host that ran the probe.

toolVersions.description: Versions of every tool the verdict depends on (always includes node).

evidence.description: Probe-specific observations backing the verdict. Free-form object.

specRefs.description: Spec anchors the probe bears on (sections, OPEN ids, oracle ids).

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the run.
